title: US states with a confirmed spotted lanternfly population

source.name: Spotted lanternfly detection/quarantine tracking
source.publisher: USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS), state departments of agriculture

notes: Cumulative count of US states with an established/confirmed spotted lanternfly population. First US detection: Berks County, Pennsylvania, 2014. By 2026, APHIS lists confirmed populations across roughly 19 states plus DC. Intermediate points compiled from state agriculture department detection timelines (DE/VA/NJ/MD by 2018; CT/OH/NY added by 2020; IN/KY and NC/MI added by 2021-2022).
